title: OpenAI says it will make London its largest research hub outside of the US, without giving specific details; OpenAI's European headquarters are in Dublin (Sam Tabahriti/Reuters)
summary: Sam Tabahriti / Reuters: OpenAI says it will make London its largest research hub outside of the US, without giving specific details; OpenAI's European headquarters are in Dublin — ChatGPT maker OpenAI said on Thursday that it would make London its largest research hub outside the United States …
